items.content:
- [ ] door, left open, hallway light
- [ ] hand setting down a cup
- [ ] road, wrong time of day
- [ ] someone from behind, not turning
- [ ] the window (have it)
- [ ] stairs from the bottom
- [ ] a chair
- [ ] curtain, no wind
- [ ] the door again, closed

Nothing frightening in any of them. That is the point.

summary: A checklist of nine deliberately unfrightening shots for a Kuleshov cut
title: nine shots
